action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Apache Groovy incorrectly handled the
deserialization of MethodClosure objects. An attacker could possibly use
this issue to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service.
(CVE-2015-3253)

It was discovered that Apache Groovy incorrectly handled serialization
mechanisms. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary
code. (CVE-2016-6814)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in Apache Groovy.
